stem: Which instrument is specifically named for removing a nasal foreign body?
explanation: Metal ear curette. This is because this is the instrument specifically named for nasal foreign body removal; a decongestant or topical anaesthetic may be used as an adjunct, but they do not replace the extraction tool.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes

optionExplanations.A: Correct because a metal ear curette is the specifically named instrument used to remove the nasal foreign body.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because an otoscope with speculum is used for examination rather than removal.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because a light source helps with visualisation but is not the removal instrument.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because a tongue depressor is not the named tool for extracting a nasal foreign body.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because topical anaesthetic may assist comfort, but it is not the instrument used to remove the object.
